scoutingSummary: An iOS developer and technical project manager from Bensalem, PA who leads, serves and volunteers. Strengths: direct communicator, consistly seeks feedback to improve, versatile and open to change. Plays best when helping others get better: peers, students, and community members.

intangibles.title: Communicator
intangibles.text: Over five years in customer service, with customers both outside and inside the organizations I worked for.

intangibles.title: Instructor
intangibles.text: Six years teaching karate to students from age three to adult, three years as a college peer tutor, and now a Senior High Bible Study leader.

intangibles.title: Mentor
intangibles.text: A mentor to my high school robotics team & Penn State IST students, offering both professional and personal advice.

intangibles.title: Leadership
intangibles.text: In leadership roles since high school: robotics program manager, volunteer coordinator, tutoring co-coordinator, senior instructor, TPM and co-lead of the 250-member ETFCG program. Many were elected or appointed by peers.

nowSigning.heading: Now signing
nowSigning.text: Open to conversations about iOS/Swift & GoLang engineering
